stem.text: A source of sound waves with constant frequency moves towards a stationary observer.
The observer compares the sound waves arriving at the observer’s position with the waves emitted by the source of sound.
What is detected by the observer?

A.text: a decreased frequency of the sound waves

B.text: no change in frequency of the sound waves

C.text: a decreased wavelength of the sound waves

D.text: no change in wavelength of the sound waves
